exposure: Birth anoxia (global anoxia during Cesarean section)
Direct oxytocin injection to postnatal day 2 rat pups
cohort: The study included pregnant rat dams and their neonatal rat pups, as well as postnatal day 2 rat pups.
finding: Maternal oxytocin administration before birth significantly increased brain lactate and decreased brain ATP in anoxic neonatal rat pups, suggesting it may worsen acute CNS metabolic responses to anoxia.
